answer: Concretely, the economy can lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The voyage of work and the nectar of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a opal to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
